## Basic Template

```r
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data, aes(x = var1, y = var2)) +
  geom_***()
```

## Common Geoms

### Scatter Plot
```r
ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point()
```

### Line Plot
```r
ggplot(data, aes(x = time, y = value)) +
  geom_line()
```

### Bar Chart
```r
# Count
ggplot(data, aes(x = category)) +
  geom_bar()

# With values
ggplot(data, aes(x = category, y = value)) +
  geom_col()
```

### Box Plot
```r
ggplot(data, aes(x = group, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

### Histogram
```r
ggplot(data, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30)
```

### Density
```r
ggplot(data, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_density()
```

### Violin Plot
```r
ggplot(data, aes(x = group, y = value)) +
  geom_violin()
```

## Aesthetics

### Inside aes() - Map to data
```r
aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = cyl, size = hp, shape = gear)
```

### Outside aes() - Fixed values
```r
geom_point(color = "red", size = 3, alpha = 0.5)
```

### Common Aesthetics
| Aesthetic | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `x`, `y` | Position |
| `color` | Point/line color |
| `fill` | Fill color |
| `size` | Point size |
| `shape` | Point shape |
| `alpha` | Transparency |
| `linetype` | Line type |

## Adding Layers

### Trend Lines
```r
geom_smooth(method = "lm")      # Linear
geom_smooth(method = "loess")   # Smooth curve
geom_smooth(se = FALSE)         # No confidence band
```

### Reference Lines
```r
geom_hline(yintercept = 50)
geom_vline(xintercept = 10)
geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0)
```

### Text/Labels
```r
geom_text(aes(label = name))
geom_label(aes(label = name))
```

### Error Bars
```r
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2)
```

## Faceting

### By Rows
```r
facet_grid(rows ~ .)
```

### By Columns
```r
facet_grid(. ~ cols)
```

### Wrap
```r
facet_wrap(~variable, ncol = 3)
```

## Scales

### Color/Fill
```r
scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "blue"))
scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
scale_color_viridis_d()  # Colorblind-friendly
```

### Axes
```r
scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100))
scale_y_log10()
scale_x_discrete(labels = c("A", "B", "C"))
```

## Labels

```r
labs(
  title = "Main Title",
  subtitle = "Subtitle",
  x = "X-axis Label",
  y = "Y-axis Label",
  color = "Legend Title",
  caption = "Source: data"
)
```

## Themes

### Built-in Themes
```r
theme_classic()    # Clean, no gridlines
theme_minimal()    # Minimal
theme_bw()         # Black and white
theme_void()       # Empty
```

### Custom Theme Elements
```r
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  panel.grid = element_blank()
)
```

### Legend Position
```r
theme(legend.position = "bottom")  # bottom, top, left, right
theme(legend.position = "none")    # Remove legend
theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.8))  # Coordinates
```

## Saving Plots

```r
ggsave("figure.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("figure.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("figure.tiff", width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
```

## Colorblind-Friendly Palette

```r
okabe_ito <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442",
               "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#999999")

scale_color_manual(values = okabe_ito)
```

## Complete Example

```r
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Cylinders") +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel Efficiency vs Weight",
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "Miles per Gallon"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.85),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
